digest.component_or_area: test design standards and convergence test authoring
propositions: Convergence tests that re-derive external effects using the same helpers as the production code under test remain green when the production code drifts, failing to catch the convergence breakage they exist to detect

The defective re-derived oracle pattern is syntactically identical to legitimate characterization tests that intentionally pin helper behavior, making automated detection infeasible without unacceptable false positives

The capture-don't-re-derive rule must be recorded as normative authoring guidance in the shared test-design standard and synced byte-identically across all skill copies to make it discoverable and enforceable

The concrete convergence defect (stale truncate_comment_body model and re-derived fit_preserving_marker composition) was fixed in commit 103729e90c by capturing real call-site output instead of recomputing it
